note: Node's phone path: every frame one phone got from a cause's send to a marker's answer, per scenario, mode and reader, over every run; `orders` is the set of distinct orders with their counts.

terminal-dispose.what: termDispose of a tab whose command is running: its termActivity (null) is published while the call is handled

activity-after-answer.what: a call answered (listProjects), then, once its answer has its place, three activity changes of a running tab (finished, running, finished: OSC 697;D;0, C, D;0): never-dropped events queued after an answer, one after another

state-latest-wins.what: three successive host states published to the relay's state lane (remote-relay-session-wiring.ts:104-107), then a call: one state frame in flight, the later ones collapsed to the newest (desktop-service-protocol.ts:57-99), the answer queued behind the first

room-rename.what: agentRoomAction update of the room's name: the room log's catalog row is republished while the call is handled

thread-favorite.what: setSessionFavorite of a listed session: its catalog row is republished while the call is handled
